visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a spacious airport hall. A man and a young boy stand in the center, both wearing black t-shirts with a Stitch character print. The man smiles and gestures. A woman wearing a matching black shirt and denim shorts walks into the frame from the right, joined quickly by a little girl in a similar outfit and blue skirt. In the foreground, a white table holds a colorful bead maze toy, while a black stroller and green seating are visible in the background. The lighting is bright and natural from large windows in the distance. (2) The setting shifts to a hotel bedroom. The same four family members are present, now dressed in matching white t-shirts with a Mickey Mouse print. They are in the middle of jumping or dancing together between two large beds. The room features dark wood furniture and headboards decorated with circular mouse silhouettes. The lighting is warm and indoor. (3) The final phase captures a nighttime fireworks display at a theme park. A large, ornate castle is illuminated with brilliant blue and white lights. Multi-colored fireworks—gold, red, green, and purple—explode in the night sky above the castle. In the foreground, the silhouettes of a crowd are visible, with many people holding up smartphones to record the event. Fountains of water are seen spraying at the base of the castle.
